Missions
========

*   Players get **one** new Daily Mission per day, time is based on login and can **store up to 3 missions at once**. Players also have the ability to reroll one of these missions per day if they so choose to change the mission.
*   Rerolling Daily Missions worth 225 or 300 [Defender Medals](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Medals "Defender Medals")
     is always recommended.
*   Additional missions called Bonus Missions are granted once per week. The Bonus Mission cannot be rerolled and can be different for other players.
*   Daily and Weekly Missions provide extra 750 and 3,000 experience respectively towards the [Defender Pass](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Pass "Defender Pass")
    . Weekly Missions also provide an extra 500,000 [Gold](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gold "Gold")
     on completion.
